summary: Identity Engine (Passkey/WebAuthn) validation. Backend: 19/19 pytest PASSED (init + register/begin + authenticate/begin + public GET + auth guards on /me, /objects, link-object + regression smoke on moment/sign, moment/sign-media, fk/create, fk/stats, moment/stats). Frontend: /identity page renders correctly, all required data-testid present, FREK-ID format valid, no fatal errors. CRITICAL FIX APPLIED by testing agent: rp.id was resolving to 'localhost' (missing env var) — added FREK_RP_ORIGIN support in service.py + set FREK_RP_ORIGIN in backend/.env. rp.id now correctly returns 'culture-chain.preview.emergentagent.com'.

minor.issue: Invalid identity_type returns 422 (Pydantic Literal enforcement) instead of the 400 stated in the review spec. Contract says '400'. Test accepts both — but if the frontend or clients specifically expect 400, the route code path never fires because Pydantic validates before the handler.

action_items: REVIEW the config fix: testing agent added FREK_RP_ORIGIN=https://culture-chain.preview.emergentagent.com to /app/backend/.env AND modified /app/backend/identity_engine/service.py (get_rp_id / get_origin) to prefer FREK_RP_ORIGIN then fall back to REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Previously rp.id resolved to 'localhost' because service.py only read REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL which is not defined in backend/.env. Please verify this matches the intended config strategy — the fix documented in the review request (FREK_RP_ORIGIN in backend/.env) was NOT actually applied by the previous edit; it is applied now.

OPTIONAL: If contract-strict 400 for invalid identity_type is required (vs FastAPI's default 422 from Pydantic Literal), refactor InitIdentityRequest to accept a plain str for identity_type and validate inside the handler (which already raises HTTPException 400 in the fallthrough branch). Current models.py uses Literal[...] so invalid values never reach the handler.
critical_code_review_comments: service.py get_rp_id/get_origin previously depended on REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL which is a FRONTEND env variable — semantically wrong for backend code. Now supports FREK_RP_ORIGIN as the primary source (backend-owned name).

routes.py line 95-96 checks 'identity_type not in IDENTITY_TYPES' but models.py declares identity_type as Literal — this branch is unreachable in practice. Consider aligning the two or removing the redundant check.
routes.py LinkObjectRequest defined but unused (line 327-328). Dead code.

authenticate_complete has a subtle bug: it fetches the LATEST authenticate challenge by kind=authenticate/frek_id=None sort=created_at desc — but if two users authenticate concurrently, one may pick the other's challenge doc. Consider matching challenge by the actual value from clientDataJSON (decode it) or by client-supplied opaque id.

get_linked_objects uses `verify_session_token(x_frek_session) != frek_id` — this cross-account guard is correct. However it returns 401 even for a valid but different session — could be 403 semantically (authenticated but not authorized). Minor.
Frontend Identity.jsx line 16 mixes VITE_BACKEND_URL and REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL — same pattern flagged in iteration_20.json comments; harmless but confusing.

Backend routes.py ensure_indexes() calls create_index('challenge', unique=True) BUT also has a TTL index on created_at that expires docs. If the same challenge is regenerated within TTL (extremely unlikely with 32 bytes random) the insert would fail — non-blocking, defensive design is fine.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (smoke: brand, anonymous state, frek_id format, register-btn clickable, recover-btn present, no errors)

seed_data_creation: Test data prefixed TEST_ (session_id=TEST_sess_engine_1, TEST_sess_regression*, TEST_regression*@example.com). Multiple anonymous FREKIdentity docs created in db.frek_persons via /identity/init — safe to leave (they contain no PII and are unprotected).
test_credentials: N/A — Identity Engine is anonymous-first. Passkey ceremony (register/complete + authenticate/complete) requires real hardware authenticator (Touch ID/Face ID/Windows Hello) and cannot be exercised headlessly. Skipped per review instruction.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Config fix applied: FREK_RP_ORIGIN env var + service.py priority read. Any further env changes must preserve this. Backend .env now has FREK_RP_ORIGIN=https://culture-chain.preview.emergentagent.com. The complete Passkey ceremony (create/get + verify_registration/verify_authentication) is only testable with a real authenticator device — leave to user-driven QA. All contract tests (init, both begins, public GET, auth guards) are covered in /app/backend/tests/test_identity_engine.py — reuse for regression.
rca of the issue: Root cause: /app/backend/identity_engine/service.py read the RP ID from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL which is a frontend-only variable and is NOT set in /app/backend/.env. Therefore get_rp_id() fell back to 'localhost'. The review request said FREK_RP_ORIGIN was added to backend/.env but the file did not contain it (previous edit was not persisted or was reverted). Reproduction: curl POST /api/v1/identity/{fid}/register/begin -> rp.id == 'localhost'. Impact: WebAuthn ceremony would fail in browser because rp.id must match effective document origin's hostname. Mitigation applied: (1) added FREK_RP_ORIGIN=https://culture-chain.preview.emergentagent.com in /app/backend/.env; (2) modified service.py get_rp_id/get_origin to prefer FREK_RP_ORIGIN then fall back to REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL; (3) restarted backend; (4) verified rp.id now == 'culture-chain.preview.emergentagent.com'.
